messages.content:
You help an accounts-payable team in India decide the nature of a payment to a resident vendor, for tax deduction at source (TDS). The payer is a company.

Your only job is to choose ONE category for the invoice line and show which words of the statute support it. You do not decide rates, thresholds, section numbers or amounts; other software does that.

Categories:
- CONTRACT_WORK: Carrying out any work under a contract, including supply of labour, advertising, broadcasting, carriage of goods/passengers (not rail), catering, and manufacturing to the customer's specification using material bought from the customer.
- PROFESSIONAL_FEES: Fees for professional services: legal, medical, engineering, architectural, accountancy, technical consultancy, interior decoration, advertising, or other notified professions.
- TECHNICAL_FEES: Fees for technical services: managerial, technical or consultancy services (including provision of technical or other personnel), excluding construction/assembly/mining-type projects and salary.
- DIRECTOR_FEES: Remuneration, fees or commission paid to a director of the company, other than salary.
- COMMISSION: Commission or brokerage (not insurance commission) paid to a person acting on behalf of the company.
- RENT_LAND_BUILDING: Rent for land, building, land appurtenant to a building, furniture or fittings.
- RENT_PLANT_MACHINERY: Rent for the use of machinery, plant or equipment.
- GOODS_PURCHASE: Purchase of goods (no service element), including standard goods bought off the shelf.
- NEEDS_INFO: The invoice does not contain enough facts to choose between categories. Say which facts are missing.

Rules:
1. Use only the statute clauses given in the user message. Do not rely on section numbers, circulars or case law from memory.
2. Each citation is an exact, contiguous quote of at least 4 words copied from one clause, with that clause's id.
3. If the line could reasonably fall into two categories that are taxed differently and the invoice text does not settle which, answer NEEDS_INFO and list the facts that would settle it. Do not guess.
4. confidence is "high" only if a tax reviewer reading the same invoice and clauses would almost certainly agree; "medium" if you lean one way but a reasonable reviewer could differ; otherwise "low".
5. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"category": "<CATEGORY>", "citations": [{"chunk_id": "<id>", "quote": "<exact words>"}], "missing_facts": ["<fact>"], "confidence": "high|medium|low", "rationale": "<one or two sentences>"}

Statute clauses in force on 2026-03-16 (ITA1961):

[1961:194C(1)] Section 194C(1) (Payments to contractors) — operative words
Any person responsible for paying any sum to any resident (hereafter in this section referred to as the contractor) for carrying out any work (including supply of labour for carrying out any work) in pursuance of a contract between the contractor and a specified person shall, at the time of credit of such sum to the account of the contractor or at the time of payment thereof in cash or by issue of a cheque or draft or by any other mode, whichever is earlier, deduct an amount equal to-(i) one per cent. where the payment is being made or credit is being given to an individual or a Hindu undivided family; (ii) two per cent. where the payment is being made or credit is being given to a person other than an individual or a Hindu undivided family, of such sum as income-tax on income comprised therein.

[1961:194C-Expl(iv)] Section 194C, Explanation (iv) ("work")
"work" shall include-(a) advertising; (b) broadcasting and telecasting including production of programmes for such broadcasting or telecasting; (c) carriage of goods or passengers by any mode of transport other than by railways; (d) catering; (e) manufacturing or supplying a product according to the requirement or specification of a customer by using material purchased from such customer, but does not include manufacturing or supplying a product according to the requirement or specification of a customer by using material purchased from a person, other than such customer.

[1961:194J-Expl] Section 194J, Explanation (a) and (b) ("professional services", "fees for technical services")
(a) "professional services" means services rendered by a person in the course of carrying on legal, medical, engineering or architectural profession or the profession of accountancy or technical consultancy or interior decoration or advertising or such other profession as is notified by the Board for the purposes of section 44-AA or of this section; (b) "fees for technical services" shall have the same meaning as in Explanation 2 to clause (vii) of sub-section (1) of section 9;

[1961:9(1)(vii)-Expl2] Section 9(1)(vii), Explanation 2 ("fees for technical services")
"fees for technical services" means any consideration (including any lump sum consideration) for the rendering of any managerial, technical or consultancy services (including the provision of services of technical or other personnel) but does not include consideration for any construction, assembly, mining or like project undertaken by the recipient or consideration which would be income of the recipient chargeable under the head "Salaries".

[1961:194H-Expl(i)] Section 194H, Explanation (i) ("commission or brokerage")
"commission or brokerage" includes any payment received or receivable, directly or indirectly, by a person acting on behalf of another person for services rendered (not being professional services) or for any services in the course of buying or selling of goods or in relation to any transaction relating to any asset, valuable article or thing, not being securities;

[1961:194I-Expl(i)] Section 194-I, Explanation (i) ("rent")
"rent" means any payment, by whatever name called, under any lease, sub-lease, tenancy or any other agreement or arrangement for the use of (either separately or together) any,- (a) land; or (b) building (including factory building); or (c) land appurtenant to a building (including factory building); or (d) machinery; or (e) plant; or (f) equipment; or (g) furniture; or (h) fittings, whether or not any or all of the above are owned by the payee;

Invoice line:
Vendor: Neha Kapoor, Architect
Description: Architectural drawings for warehouse extension - stage 1 (concept design)
SAC code: 998323

response: {"category": "PROFESSIONAL_FEES", "citations": [{"chunk_id": "1961:194J-Expl", "quote": "professional services means services rendered by a person in the course of carrying on legal, medical, engineering or architectural profession"}], "missing_facts": [], "confidence": "high", "rationale": "The invoice is for architectural concept design drawings by an identified architect, which falls squarely under 'professional services' as defined in Section 194J Explanation (a) that explicitly includes the architectural profession."}
